protocol: Final untouched issuer. Pre-registered before asking any Costco model question. Five income, four balance sheet, two cash flow and three geographic segment disclosures; four out-of-period refusals. Standalone filing with intact text rows and 80 physical pages. Issuer's illustrated annual report was excluded at file preflight because its native extracted text fragments words across lines; no model questions were run on that alternative. USD millions.
